messages.subject: error message when combine geom_ribbon and geom_point
parts:
Dear users,

I am using ggplot2 version 0.8.9 and I am encountering an error message "Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'Lower' not found" with the following code to draw a graph with ribbons and points,

ggplot(qSum,aes(x=TSLD,ymin=Lower,ymax=Upper))+geom_ribbon(alpha=0.5,fill="blue")+
geom_point(data=nmData2,aes(TSLD,CONC))+
facet_wrap(~STDY,scales = "free")

The weird thing is that if remove the geom_point line, it works and the code is able to draw ribbons:

ggplot(qSum,aes(x=TSLD,ymin=Lower,ymax=Upper))+geom_ribbon(alpha=0.5,fill="blue")+
#geom_point(data=nmData2,aes(TSLD,CONC))+
facet_wrap(~STDY,scales = "free")

It was also confirmed that without geom_ribbon, the code for geom_points also works. Can anyone help to figure out what is the problem here. Thanks in advance!

On Wed, Dec 5, 2012 at 8:35 PM, pharmpk <yanxia...@gmail.com> wrote:
Dear users,

I am using ggplot2 version 0.8.9 and I am encountering an error message "Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'Lower' not found" with the following code to draw a graph with ribbons and points,

ggplot(qSum,aes(x=TSLD,ymin=Lower,ymax=Upper))+geom_ribbon(alpha=0.5,fill="blue")+
geom_point(data=nmData2,aes(TSLD,CONC))+
facet_wrap(~STDY,scales = "free")

Notice that you defined ymin and ymax as aesthetics in the *base* ggplot; it will expect to find these aesthetics in all subsequent layers. Redo the code as follows:

ggplot(qSum, aes(x = TSLD, y = CONC)) +
   geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), fill = "blue", alpha = 0.5) +
   geom_point() +
   facet_wrap(~ STDY, scales = "free") 

In this form. the common aesthetics are x and y, while ymin and ymax are specific to geom_ribbon().

The weird thing is that if remove the geom_point line, it works and the code is able to draw ribbons:

ggplot(qSum,aes(x=TSLD,ymin=Lower,ymax=Upper))+geom_ribbon(alpha=0.5,fill="blue")+
#geom_point(data=nmData2,aes(TSLD,CONC))+
facet_wrap(~STDY,scales = "free")

It was also confirmed that without geom_ribbon, the code for geom_points also works. Can anyone help to figure out what is the problem here. Thanks in advance!
